scope: Only arbitrate the two timestamp/date-granularity questions already recorded in EVT-001-kwinana-archive-plan-v1. Do not broaden Kwinana discovery.

findings.question: Can the 2018-12-18 body dateline on Tianqi's commissioning release be used as exact public known_time?
findings.reason: The event date is well supported, but the surviving Tianqi web copies carry later page timestamps. A contemporaneous local report proves the event and commissioning status were public by 2018-12-21, but it does not prove when Tianqi's specific release first became public.

candidate_sources.claim_anchor: Stage One commissioning will commence at the end of this year; Stage Two expected to be commissioned at the end of 2019.
candidate_sources.use: archive as an expectation-bearing source, but do not assign known_time=2018-12-18 solely from its body dateline

candidate_sources.claim_anchor: Same Kwinana staff-move / commissioning release text.
candidate_sources.use: preserve as evidence of current mirror/version ambiguity, not as an independent source

candidate_sources.claim_anchor: Office opening occurred Tuesday 2018-12-18; Stage 1 construction was near completion and commissioning was about to begin.
candidate_sources.use: bounds public knowledge of the event/commissioning status to no later than 2018-12-21; not a substitute for first-party exact publication timestamp

candidate_sources.claim_anchor: States that the 24ktpa Kwinana project entered equipment commissioning on 2018-12-18.
candidate_sources.use: supports event valid_time, not exact contemporaneous public known_time

temporal_representation.precision_rule: Until an archived contemporaneous filing/release timestamp is found, keep exact first-party known_time unresolved rather than backdating the surviving page to its body dateline.

findings.next_action: During normal archive execution, archive the two Tianqi copies as one source-origin cluster plus the contemporaneous local report if useful for known-time bounding; continue a narrowly scoped exchange/archive lookup only if exact first-party known_time materially affects the replay fixture.

findings.question: Is 2022-11-30 inconsistent with later first-party descriptions saying commercial production began in December 2022?
findings.reason: The December 2022 Tianqi project-progress disclosure says management expected output to improve from December and the company judged Train 1 capable of commercial production from 2022-11-30. Later annual-report wording uses month-level 'since December 2022'. IGO later states commercial production was declared on 2022-11-30. These can be represented as a day-level declaration/effective date plus month-level operating-period wording rather than forced into one date field.

candidate_sources.claim_anchor: Company judges Train 1 reached the capability for commercial production from 2022-11-30; output expected to increase steadily from December 2022.
candidate_sources.use: discovery pointer to the exact Tianqi/CNINFO announcement that should be archived as the primary source

candidate_sources.claim_anchor: IGO states commercial production was declared on Train 1 on 30 November 2022.
candidate_sources.use: later independent primary corroboration of the day-level declaration; not a replacement for the contemporaneous Tianqi announcement

candidate_sources.claim_anchor: Describes Train 1 as having achieved commercial production since December 2022 and still being in ramp-up.
candidate_sources.use: Outcome context with month-level precision; do not treat month-level wording as contradiction of the 2022-11-30 declaration/effective date

temporal_representation.expectation_horizon_from_same_disclosure: output expected to improve steadily from 2022-12
temporal_representation.precision_rule: Store day-level declaration/effective date and month-level operating-period statement separately. Reopen conflict only if archived primary wording materially disagrees.

findings.next_action: Archive the exact CNINFO/Tianqi 2022-083 announcement in the normal runtime and ground the 2022-11-30 and December-ramp statements to source locators. Downgrade the previous 2022-11-30 versus 2022-12 item from presumed date conflict to a temporal-granularity reconciliation item, subject to archived-primary confirmation.

impact_on_archive_plan.recommended_update_after_archive: Represent 2018 as unresolved exact first-party known_time with a public-knowledge upper bound unless a contemporaneous timestamp is archived. Represent 2022-11-30 and 2022-12 as different temporal semantics unless the archived 2022-083 primary source forces a conflict.
